title: Data Analyst
text: Netsol Technologies is hiring a Data Analyst for its office in Lahore. You will build weekly dashboards in Tableau, write SQL queries against our sales warehouse and present findings to the finance team. At least two years of experience with Python and Excel is required. The role offers a salary of PKR 180,000 per month and health insurance for the whole family.

title: Backend Engineer
text: Careem is looking for a Backend Engineer to join its payments team in Dubai. You will design and maintain microservices written in Python and Go, deploy them on AWS, and monitor them with Grafana. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a strong plus. Applications close on 30 November 2025.

title: UI/UX Designer
text: Systems Limited needs a UI/UX Designer in Karachi to lead the redesign of its mobile banking app. The design must be accessible and consistent across Android and iOS. You should be fluent in Figma and comfortable running usability tests with real customers. Candidates with a portfolio of three shipped products will be shortlisted first.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
text: Arbisoft is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer in Islamabad. You will train and test deep learning models in PyTorch, track experiments, and ship them to production on AWS. A degree in computer science and four years of Python experience are expected. The team works a hybrid schedule with two remote days every week.

title: Frontend Developer
text: Shopify is seeking a Frontend Developer based in Toronto. Your day will involve building React components, writing unit tests in Jest, and reviewing pull requests from other engineers. Knowledge of TypeScript and Figma handoff workflows is useful. The position pays between $95,000 and $120,000 a year.

title: Cloud Support Engineer
text: Amazon Web Services is hiring a Cloud Support Engineer in Dublin to support enterprise customers through complex outages. You will troubleshoot networking issues on AWS, document every fix, and escalate critical incidents to the service teams. Strong Linux skills and some Python scripting are required. Shifts rotate every 12 weeks.

title: Product Manager
text: Daraz is looking for a Product Manager in Lahore to lead the checkout squad. You will test new ideas with A/B experiments, write clear specifications and work closely with designers who use Figma every day. Basic SQL is needed to read your own metrics. The successful candidate will report to the Director of Product.

title: Data Engineer
text: Spotify is recruiting a Data Engineer in Stockholm to build streaming pipelines with Apache Kafka and Spark. The pipelines process over 500 million events per day. You must write production Python, model tables in SQL and run jobs on Google Cloud. The team offers relocation support and a 10 percent annual bonus.

title: QA Automation Engineer
text: TPS Worldwide has an opening for a QA Automation Engineer in Karachi. You will design automated test suites in Selenium and Python, run them in Jenkins, and report defects to the development team. The first round of interviews starts on 15 December 2025.

title: DevOps Engineer
text: 10Pearls is hiring a DevOps Engineer in Islamabad to manage infrastructure on AWS and Azure. Daily work includes writing Terraform modules, maintaining Docker images and keeping Kubernetes clusters healthy. Experience with Python or Bash scripting is required, and the support rota includes one weekend per month.
